The '''S-SC4 Bloodmark''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] which performed in scout roles. Created by the [[Tandankin shipyards]], the Bloodmark sacrificed some speed and maneuverability in exchange for advanced sensors and communications technology, as it served as [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] coordinator in battle.

==Behind the scenes==
The S-SC4 Bloodmark was introduced in the [[2014]] expansion [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter|''Galactic Starfighter'']] to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. A pet model of the starfighter was released in the
[[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]].
